{{Top|leg}}
A '''punch gun''' was a type of weapon. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] owned one as a youth on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was powerful enough to sever a [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc's]] tentacle.
